newsitem.title: FRANCE: France seizes 2.5 tonnes of cannabis from Spain.
newsitem.headline: France seizes 2.5 tonnes of cannabis from Spain.

text.p: French customs said on Thursday they had seized more than 2.5 tonnes of cannabis resin in two separate hauls in trucks driving in from Spain.
They seized 2.1 tonnes of the drug concealed as soap bars in a Polish-registered truck stopped in northeastern France on its way from Alcira, near Seville, to Janowice in Poland.
In another haul, two Britons were being held after customs officers at the Franco-Spanish border found 490 kilos (nearly half a tonne) of the drug on their truck.
